metadata.title: ETFs focused on AI investing theme catch strong bid - MarketWatch

content.text:
7 hours ago
ETFs focused on AI investing theme catch strong bid
Exchange-traded funds that provide exposure to the artificial-intelligence investing theme were catching a strong bid on Friday afternoon, as investor appetite for the AI trade returned.
The iShares A.I. Innovation and Tech Active ETF — whose top three holdings on Thursday were Nvidia, Micron Technology and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing — was rallying 4%, while the Roundhill Generative AI & Technology ETF was gaining 3.7%. The iShares Future Robotics and Related Technologies Active ETF —whose three largest weights in its portfolio on Thursday were Tesla, Lincoln Electric Holdings and Nvidia —was up 3.1%.
All three ETFs were recovering from steep drops on Thursday and were on track for weekly losses.
